title: Provenance-Aware Resource Graph & Deterministic Resource Retrieval
research_question: Can external software knowledge be represented as a provenance-aware, version-aware graph and retrieved as bounded evidence without contaminating the internal repository, positive-experience, or negative-experience graphs?
components_implemented: lifecore_swe.resources.graph.index (ResourceGraph with associative type, source, package, and status indexing)
lifecore_swe.resources.graph.builder (ResourceGraphBuilder inferring SOURCED_FROM, DOCUMENTS, VERSION_OF, EXAMPLE_FOR, DEPENDS_ON, REFERENCES)
lifecore_swe.resources.graph.ranking (ResourceRanker with multi-attribute scoring: relevance, authority, version, freshness, trust, status, confidence)
lifecore_swe.resources.graph.retriever (ResourceGraphRetriever with multi-hop expansion, filtering, bounded selection, and context formatting)
security_boundary_isolation: VERIFIED (Zero mutation of GraphIndex, ExperienceGraphOverlay, or NegativeGraphOverlay)
